run_protoc_test: run the ProtocTest unittest suite to verify grpc_tools protoc dynamic proto and service importing
test_import_protos: test that grpc_tools protoc can dynamically import proto definitions from a .proto file
test_import_services: test that grpc_tools protoc can dynamically import service stubs from a .proto file
test_combined_import: test that grpc_tools protoc can import both protos and services together in one call
test_syntax_errors: test that grpc_tools protoc raises descriptive errors with line numbers for flawed proto files
